pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about using doXmind, the AI-powered writing assistant.

gettingStarted.heading: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: doXmind has three main areas. The <bold>Outline Sidebar</bold> (left) shows your document structure. The <bold>Editor</bold> (center) is where you write. The <bold>AI Chat</bold> (right) lets you interact with AI.
gettingStarted.createFirstDesc: Click the <bold>+ New Document</bold> button on the home dashboard, or use the Command Palette and type "New Document".
gettingStarted.onboardingDesc: When you first sign in, an interactive tour walks you through the key features. You can restart it anytime from the user menu → <bold>Restart Tour</bold>.

homeDashboard.heading: Home Dashboard
homeDashboard.description: The home dashboard is your central hub for finding, creating, and managing documents. It features a dual-mode search bar, recent files, favorites, and quick actions.
homeDashboard.searchIntro: The search bar at the top has two modes, toggled by the pill buttons on the left:
homeDashboard.askAiModeDesc: (default): Type a question about your writing and press Enter. The AI searches across all your documents and returns an answer with source citations. You can ask follow-up questions in the answer card for a multi-turn conversation.
homeDashboard.searchModeDesc: Type to search documents by title or content. Results appear instantly as you type (300ms debounce). Each result shows a relevance score and a highlighted snippet matching your query.
homeDashboard.continueWritingDesc: Your 3 most recently edited documents appear at the top for quick access. Click any tile to open it in the editor.
homeDashboard.favoritesDesc: Star important documents by clicking the star icon in the file menu. Starred documents are pinned in a dedicated Favorites section on the dashboard.
homeDashboard.creatingDocsIntro: Click the + button in the top-right corner of the file grid. A dropdown offers four options:
homeDashboard.newDocumentDesc: Creates a blank document and opens it in the editor.
homeDashboard.newFolderDesc: Creates a folder at the root level to organize files.
homeDashboard.fromTemplateDesc: Pick from 4 templates: Welcome tutorial, Blank, Blog Post, or Meeting Notes.
homeDashboard.importFileDesc: Upload a PDF, DOCX, or Markdown file to convert into a document.
homeDashboard.fileActionsIntro: Hover over any file card (or tap the three-dot menu on mobile) to access actions:
homeDashboard.renameDesc: Change the file or folder name
homeDashboard.exportAsDesc: Download as Markdown, PDF, or Word
homeDashboard.gridListViewDesc: Toggle between card grid and compact list using the view icons in the top-right corner. On mobile, documents display as a horizontal swipeable carousel.
homeDashboard.sortDesc: Click the sort icon to order files by name (A–Z / Z–A), modified date, or created date. Folders always appear first.
homeDashboard.dragDropDesc: Drag files onto folder cards to move them into that folder. Drag files to the "All Files" breadcrumb to move them back to the root.

editor.heading: Editor Basics
editor.description: The editor supports rich markdown with a what-you-see-is-what-you-get experience. Format text using the toolbar, keyboard shortcuts, or markdown syntax.
editor.headingsDesc: Three levels (H1–H3) via shortcut, or type #, ##, ### followed by a space.
editor.listsDesc: Bullet, Numbered, and Task lists with checkboxes.
editor.codeBlocksDesc: Fenced with ```. Supports syntax highlighting with a language selector and line numbers.
editor.mathBlocksDesc: Inline math with $...$ and display math with $$...$$. Supports full LaTeX syntax.
editor.tablesDesc: Insert via slash command. Use the column/row menus to add, remove, or reorder rows and columns.
editor.otherBlocksDesc: Callouts (info, warning, error, success), Toggle/collapsible sections, Images (with resize handles), and Horizontal dividers.
editor.slashTip: Type / at the start of a new line to open the slash command menu and quickly insert any block type.

quickEdit.heading: AI Quick Edit
quickEdit.description: Select any text in the editor to see a floating AI menu with instant editing options. The AI processes your selection and shows a visual diff you can accept or reject.
quickEdit.translateDesc: EN, ZH, ES, FR, DE, JA
quickEdit.askInChatTip: Choose <bold>Ask in Chat</bold> at the bottom of the menu to send your selection to the AI chat with a custom instruction.

autocomplete.heading: AI Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: As you type, the AI suggests continuations displayed as ghost text after your cursor. Suggestions appear automatically after a brief pause, or trigger them manually.
autocomplete.autoTriggerDesc: Pause typing for ~750ms and a suggestion appears. Press Tab to accept, or Esc to dismiss.
autocomplete.manualTriggerDesc: Press Alt+/ at any time to request a suggestion immediately.
autocomplete.longModeDesc: Press Ctrl+Shift+Space to get a multi-sentence suggestion instead of a short one.
autocomplete.adaptiveDesc: AI picks short or long based on context
autocomplete.shortDesc: One word + at most one more
autocomplete.disabledTip: Autocomplete is disabled inside code blocks, tables, headings, and math blocks to avoid unwanted suggestions. Configure modes in Settings → Typography.

chat.heading: AI Chat
chat.description: The AI chat panel lets you have a conversation with Claude about your document. Ask questions, request edits, brainstorm ideas, or have the AI rewrite entire sections.
chat.sidebarModeDesc: Chat panel sits to the right of the editor. Drag the border to resize.
chat.floatingModeDesc: Chat window overlays the editor. Move it anywhere on screen.
chat.sendMessagesDesc: Type in the input box and press Enter. Use Shift+Enter for a new line.
chat.voiceInputDesc: Press and hold the microphone button for at least 1 second, then release to send your transcribed speech.
chat.imageAttachmentsDesc: Click the image button or paste an image. Up to 10 images per message (5MB each).
chat.quickSuggestionsDesc: Click the suggestion chips (e.g., "Summarize document", "Brainstorm ideas") for instant prompts.
chat.documentEditingDesc: The AI can directly edit your document during chat. Changes appear as a visual diff you can accept or reject.
chat.extendedThinkingDesc: Enable deep reasoning mode for complex requests that require multi-step analysis.

diffReview.heading: Diff Review
diffReview.description: When the AI edits your document (via Quick Edit or Chat), changes are shown as a visual diff. Green highlights indicate additions; red highlights indicate removals.
diffReview.acceptRejectDesc: Each change (hunk) has its own Accept and Reject buttons. Click to apply or discard that specific change.
diffReview.bulkActionsDesc: Use Accept All or Reject All in the toolbar to process all changes at once.
diffReview.versionSnapshotsDesc: When you accept edits, a version snapshot is automatically saved. You can always restore to a previous version from the version history panel.

knowledgeBase.heading: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.description: Upload reference documents so the AI can search and cite them when answering your questions. Perfect for research papers, specifications, or reference material.
knowledgeBase.supportedFormatsDesc: PDF, DOCX, and PPTX files. Upload multiple files at once via drag-and-drop or the file picker.
knowledgeBase.processingDesc: After upload, files are chunked and indexed for vector search. Status indicators show: uploading → processing → indexed.
knowledgeBase.howItWorksDesc: When you ask the AI a question, it automatically searches your uploaded documents and references relevant passages in its response, with source citations.
knowledgeBase.perConversationDesc: Each chat conversation has its own set of attachments. Different conversations can reference different documents.

search.heading: Search & Navigation
search.description: Quickly find anything in your documents and navigate your workspace.
search.semanticSearchDesc: Press Ctrl+Shift+F to open AI-powered semantic search. Unlike plain text search, this understands meaning — search for "budget discussion" to find paragraphs about financial planning even if they don't contain those exact words. Results are ranked by relevance with highlighting.
search.findReplaceDesc: Press Ctrl+F for traditional text search within your document. Supports case-sensitive, whole word, and regex modes. Navigate matches with arrow buttons or Enter / Shift+Enter.
search.commandPaletteDesc: Press Ctrl+K to open the command palette. Quickly access any action: create documents, toggle panels, change themes, search files, and more. Start typing to filter results.
search.quickFileSwitcherDesc: Press Ctrl+Tab to quickly switch between your open and recent documents.

documents.heading: Document Management
documents.description: Organize your documents with folders, manage versions, and export to multiple formats.
documents.foldersDesc: Create folders at the root level to organize your documents hierarchically. Drag and drop files between folders, or drag to the "All Files" breadcrumb to move files back to the root.
documents.bulkActionsDesc: Select multiple files to delete or move them together.
documents.trashDesc: Deleted files go to the trash first. Open the trash panel (trash icon in the top-right corner of the file grid) to recover or permanently delete files.
documents.importDesc: Click the + button → Import File to upload a PDF, DOCX, or Markdown file. The file is converted and opened in the editor automatically.
documents.templatesDesc: Click + → From Template to start from a pre-built structure:
documents.blankDocumentDesc: Empty canvas to start from scratch
documents.blogPostDesc: Article with intro, body, and conclusion
documents.meetingNotesDesc: Agenda, notes, and action items table
documents.versionHistoryP1: Every change is tracked. Open the version history panel to browse all saved versions. Each version is tagged with its type: manual save, AI edit, quick edit, or restored.
documents.versionHistoryP2: Click any version to preview it. Use <bold>Restore</bold> to revert your document to that point.

presentation.heading: Presentation Mode
presentation.description: Turn your document into a full-screen slideshow. Present directly from your writing without exporting to a separate presentation tool.
presentation.activateDesc: Press F5 or click the presentation button in the header toolbar.
presentation.slideSplittingDesc: Slides are created from horizontal dividers (---) in your document. If none are found, the document splits at H1/H2 headings.
presentation.navigateDesc: Use ← → arrow keys or click the on-screen navigation buttons. Dot indicators show your current position.
presentation.exitDesc: Press Esc or click the exit button.
presentation.coverSlideTip: The first slide automatically becomes a cover slide with your document title. Add --- between sections to control exactly where slides break.

outline.heading: Outline & Mindlines
outline.description: Navigate your document structure at a glance with the outline sidebar and the visual mindlines map.
outline.outlineSidebarDesc: Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+O. Shows all headings (H1–H6) in a nested tree. Click any heading to scroll directly to that section. Drag the border to resize.
outline.mindlinesDesc: A visual node-based map of your document headings. Click nodes to navigate. Toggle between expanded and collapsed views for a minimal, line-indicator mode.

customization.heading: Customization
customization.description: Personalize your writing environment to match your preferences.
customization.typographyDesc: Font family (Sans / Serif / Mono), font size (Small / Normal / Large), and line height (Compact / Normal / Relaxed). Access via user menu → Settings → Typography.
customization.editorWidthDesc: Switch between Narrow, Normal, Wide, and Full width. Cycle through options via the Command Palette.
customization.themesDesc: Light, Dark, or System (follows your OS). Plus a High Contrast mode for accessibility. Toggle in the header with the sun/moon icon.
customization.spellcheckDesc: Real-time spell and grammar checking. Toggle on/off in the header toolbar. Click underlined words to see correction suggestions.

sharing.heading: Sharing
sharing.description: Share your documents with anyone via a read-only link. No sign-up required for viewers.
sharing.generateLinkDesc: Click the Share button in the header. A unique URL is generated for your document. Copy it to share with others.
sharing.viewerExperienceDesc: Viewers see a clean, read-only version of your document with the outline sidebar for navigation. They can also enter presentation mode.

shortcuts.heading: Keyboard Shortcuts
shortcuts.description: Press Ctrl+? anywhere in the app to see this reference.
